newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia c.bank cuts key refinancing rate to 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Latvia c.bank cuts key refinancing rate to 8 pct.

text.p: The central bank of Latvia cut its key refinancing rate on Friday to eight percent from 9.5 percent, the bank said.
The bank said in a statement relatively low inflation, a rapid fall in government T-bill rates and in interest rates on the interbank market allowed it to continue its rate reduction policy.

Standard & Poor's investment grade credit rating also spurred increased foreign participation in Latvia's financial market and helped T-bill rates fall closer to levels in developed eastern countries.
